entries.title: Indian Carnatic Music Concert
entries.description: The Carnatic vocal concert will be presented by Ashwin Srikant, supported by Vignesh Thyagarajan on Violin, Amit Ranganthan on Mrudangam and A.V. Krishnan on ghatam.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: Saratoga 图书馆与 SR Fine Arts 合作，邀请湾区印度社区音乐家带来印度卡纳提克音乐会。

entries.title: Dungeons & Dragons Teen Club
entries.description: To become part of this club you must have attended the Session 0 event on Saturday, August 15th and committed to playing for the entire Spring 2026 semester.
entries.priorTitleZh: 青少年《龙与地下城》俱乐部
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 如希望在有空位时收到通知，或了解其他《龙与地下城》活动，请联系青少年图书管理员 Hannah Clement：hannah.clement@lib.sccgov.org。青少年《龙与地下城》俱乐部今天举行聚会。

entries.title: Baby Sign and Sing
entries.description: Adult Caregivers will learn basic signs to communicate with their babies.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 欢迎到一楼活动室参加宝宝手语与歌唱活动！

entries.title: Winter Magic Show with Magician Mike Della Penna
entries.description: Come warm yourself this season with a little fun and a whole lot of wonder at a magic show inspired by the most magical season of the year, a time of shorter days, colder nights, and annual celebrations of light!
entries.priorTitleZh: 魔术师 Mike Della Penna 冬季魔术秀
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 这场魔术秀以白昼变短、夜晚变冷以及每年灯光庆典的冬季为灵感，带来欢乐与惊奇。

entries.title: Domingos de Matiné con merienda
entries.description: After the movie, there will be a brief discussion about the movie’s history, its making and themes.
entries.priorTitleZh: 周日电影与点心（Domingos de Matiné con merienda）
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 电影结束后将简短讨论影片的历史、制作过程和主题。观影时还会提供点心！

entries.title: Once Upon a Nutcracker
entries.description: Once Upon a Nutcracker is a 55-minute family-friendly performance designed for toddlers, preschoolers, and young children, Friday December 11, 2026 at 1:00 PM at Center for the Performing Arts.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: San Jose Dance Theatre 为幼儿和学龄前儿童呈献一场适合全家观看、时长 55 分钟的《胡桃夹子》入门演出，包含芭蕾选段和幕后介绍。

entries.title: Alice in Wonderland Jr.
entries.description: Children’s Musical Theater San Jose presents Alice in Wonderland Jr. at Montgomery Theater February 10–14, 2027. Showtimes are listed on the official theater event page.
entries.priorDescriptionZh: CMT San Jose 呈献青少年音乐剧《爱丽丝梦游仙境》。爱丽丝掉进兔子洞，遇见白兔、疯帽匠、柴郡猫和红心皇后。演出于二月 10 日至 14 日期间择日举行。
